html:
G'oya

Takror bu bir xil (talaba, kurs) juftligi bilan bir nechta qator. Shu juftlik bo'yicha guruhlab, HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 bilan bittadan ko'p qatorli guruhlarni qoldiramiz. Ism va kurs nomi faqat chiqarish uchun kerak.

Yechim

SELECT s.name, c.title, COUNT(*) AS times
FROM enrollments e
JOIN students s ON s.id = e.student_id
JOIN courses c ON c.id = e.course_id
GROUP BY e.student_id, e.course_id, s.name, c.title
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

Guruhlash kaliti id'lar. s.name va c.title GROUP BY ga faqat SELECT da ishlatish uchun qo'shilgan, guruhlar soni ulardan o'zgarmaydi.

Tuzoqlar

Ism bo'yicha guruhlash eng ko'p uchraydigan xato. Namunada ikkita Aziz bor: biri Toshkentdan, biri Namangandan, ikkalasi Python'ga bir martadan yozilgan. Ism bo'yicha guruhlansa, ular bitta "Aziz, Python, 2" qatoriga qo'shilib ketadi:

Noto'g'riSELECT s.name, c.title, COUNT(*) AS times
FROM enrollments e
JOIN students s ON s.id = e.student_id
JOIN courses c ON c.id = e.course_id
GROUP BY s.name, c.title
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

HAVING COUNT(*) = 2 Bekzodni yo'qotadi, u Excel'ga uch marta yozilgan. Turli sanalarni sanash ham to'g'ri emas: Bekzodning ikki yozilishi bir kunda bo'lgan, lekin bu baribir ikki alohida yozilish.
